Source-only revision request 58434c0c-9ea3-435c-b5f7-09b48036adf7 completed in d4793913, pushed on codex/mask-pending-retention. Revised tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/APPMODEL-RECOVERY-BARRIER-PLAN.md; original commit preserved. No product edits.

1. Shared requestSaveClose durability result is exactly saved/failed and identical for all joiners of an attempt. Superseded/cancelled only affects separate per-caller dispatch; new retry cannot rewrite prior outcome.
2. Quit prepares Document decisions without disposing controllers before Develop close; existing DocumentWorkspace.close is explicitly not a suitable prepare adapter. Late veto after successful Develop close replies false once, preserves window/owner/bookmark, owner-check reopens prior visible editor and reattaches callbacks before enabling controls. Reopen failure retains visible Retry Open recovery. Added early-cancel and late-veto/reopen deterministic cases.
3. Each openFolder invocation has an owned request record and atomic finish-once callback settlement before user callback reentry. Supersession/cancel returns false once; obsolete scan completion cannot drop or repeat callback. Retryable save failure stays pending until Retry or Cancel; terminal failure retry requires a new request. Added suspended-scan/reentrant-callback cases.
4. OutputReservation captures owner, frozen target IDs, per-image generation and settings; admission spans await, worker dispatch and actual read/capture. No capture acknowledgement currently inferred from exportBatch: conservative hold through operation completion/cancellation drain. Preview/Print receive equivalent capture/drain ownership; cross-owner same-source conflicts must be admitted consistently, uncovered writers fail closed rather than imply native lease. Added paused-worker/admission/cancel tests.

Source baseline caller map remains447772f5; currentmain2cf4df3e spot checks confirm Document close/discard and detached export boundaries. git diff --check passed. All acceptance tests remain proposed/UNRUN; no B builds/tests/apps/benchmarks/heartbeat or desktop writer changes. A Core work and sole merges remain separate. Review requested, no implemented recovery claim.
